name: Dogwood RV Park
note: 77 full-hookup sites in pines on Thompson Bridge Rd south of Waynesboro, 30 min from Augusta. 2026 daily $40, weekly $225, monthly $475 (Wi-Fi, electric, water, sewer included). Much of the park is long-term - Plant Vogtle workers, traveling nurses, snowbirds - but nightly stays are offered and booked online. --Claude
